messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered alert PD12345 - service=proxy-latency - threshold=95th>500ms - 5 events in 60s. https://pagerduty.example/PD12345
amal: acked — oncall here, taking a look :eyes:
jamie: thx amal. i can grab logs / traces if you want. what region?
sasha: saw a blip on the canary graphs too, north-virginia region. no user-facing errors yet.
amal: grabbing last 30s tail from router metric stream. running: `curl -s https://metrics/api/query?m=proxy.latency.p95&range=1m`
amal: quick grep shows a handful of spikes pinned to connection warmup from a batch of small requests, looks like KV-cache miss storm hitting backend replicas.
jamie: if it's kv-warmup, might auto-resolve as caches populate. any ongoing errors in logs?
amal: skimming logs: `2026-03-15T12:34:41Z ERROR conn reset backend=kv-42 size=0` then recovery entries. no 5xx to customers in last 5m.
incident-bot: PD escalation: page routed to secondary after 3m unacked.
sasha: thanks for the heads up, but amal already acked. looks like PD escalation race (we had a short delay in ack status propagation).
amal: monitoring — latency trending down as KV warms. putting a soft mute on noisy alert for 10m to avoid churn.
jamie: +1 for soft mute. please add a note in the thread so SRE rotation knows it's intentional.
amal: note: muted PD alert PD12345 for 10m — reason: transient kv-warmup spike during rolling deploy window. no customer impact observed. :white_check_mark:
pd-bot: Alert PD12345: auto-resolved (service=proxy-latency). 6 occurrences in 4m, current state OK.
sasha: good, that was quick. recommend we tune the alert to require sustained window e.g. 3/5m above threshold before firing.
jamie: agree. also add a filter to ignore kv-warmup pattern if below X error rate.
amal: filing a tiny follow-up ticket and PR to alert-rules repo: https://git.internal/r/infra/alert-rules/pulls/432 — will propose `for: 5m` and add label `transient-cache-warmup` with suppression logic.
sasha: can we add a runbook note to the alert that suggests checking kv-prefill state? saves rotation time.
amal: yep will include runbook snippet in PR. quick snippet I intend to add to rules: ```yaml
- alert: ProxyHighP95
  expr: proxy_request_latency_p95 > 0.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    suppression: transient-cache-warmup
  annotations:
    summary: "Proxy latency p95 high"
    runbook: "Check kv-prefill, warmup metrics, and recent deploys"
```
jamie: thanks, that covers it. no customer pages, no follow-on action unless PR gets rejected.
sasha: closing the loop from oncall side — nice catch. :clap:
amal: leaving an ops note in rotation log and moving to watch mode for 15m. ping me if it flares again.
pd-bot: PD12345: incident closed.
jamie: ok all, back to normal.
